long_biography.plain_text:
The Hochstaffl commercial-vehicle network expanded across Central Europe as Herbert Kendlbacher took on senior responsibilities in its leasing businesses. Czech records place him in charge of NL-Leasing for nearly 25 years, until 2024, with authority to represent the company independently for much of that period. German registry notices also record his long management of NL-Leasing GmbH in Kiefersfelden.

Beyond operating roles, Kendlbacher has served on the Hochstaffl private foundation board since its creation in 1998. The foundation controls a holding whose interests span property, agriculture, hospitality and corporate investments. His public activities also included work as vice-chairman of SV Wörgl during the football club's return to Austria's second tier.
